sources.title: IDK-ab0ut/Yiffymix_V52-XL · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview📃 ️ This is a Diffusers-compatible version of Yiffymix v52 by chilon249. See the original page for more information. Keep in mind that this is SDXL-Lightning checkpoint model, so using fewer steps (around 12 to 25) and low guidance scale (around 4 to 6) is recommended for the best result. It's also recommended to use clip skip of 2.
